name: Differential Radiative Transfer
definition: A theory for computing the partial derivative of the interior radiance $L$ with respect to a scene parameter $\pi \in \mathbb{R}$, denoted as $\dot{L} := \partial L / \partial \pi$.
summary: Differential Radiative Transfer computes unbiased gradients of volumetric lighting by differentiating the radiative transfer equation, handling geometric discontinuities that standard path tracing cannot.
